description: Build an SMS payload (sms: URI, RFC 5724, or SMSTO:) that opens a prefilled text message. Pass the result as `data` to generate_qr_code.

format.description: sms: RFC 5724 URI (sms:+1...?body=...). smsto: the older SMSTO:number:message form some scanners expect.

phone.description: Recipient phone number, international format recommended (e.g. +14155550123)

name: qr_payload_sms
title: SMS QR payload
